title: Think twice before putting your gaming console inside a cabinet

claims.claim: Oyun konsollarinin kabinlere konulmasi performanslarini olumsuz etkileyebilir veya omurlerini kisaltabilir.

evidence.quote: doing so could hamper your console's performance or shorten its lifespan.

claims.claim: Standart PlayStation 5 oyun sirasinda 220W'a kadar enerji tuketebilir.

claims.claim: Panasonic UB820 Blu-ray oynatici en fazla 32W enerji tuketir.

claims.claim: Sony, PlayStation etrafinda yaklaşık 4 inc yani yaklasik 10 santimetre bosluk birakilmasini onermektedir.

evidence.quote: Sony recommends leaving about 4 inches (about 10 centimeters) of clearance around a PlayStation.
For proper ventilation, Sony recommends leaving about 4 inches (about 10 centimeters) of clearance around a PlayStation.

claims.claim: Microsoft, Xbox icin her tarafta 4 ila 6 inc yani 15 santimetreye kadar bosluk birakilmasini onermektedir.

evidence.quote: Microsoft is a little more aggressive with the Xbox, proposing 4 to 6 inches (up to 15 centimeters) on all sides.

claims.claim: Nintendo, Switch 2'nin acik ve havadar bir alana yerlestirilmesini tavsiye etmektedir.

evidence.quote: Nintendo simply advises docking the Switch 2 in an "open, ventilated area."
